Good news for seafood fans: most of the fish stocks we track in U.S. waters are doing well! Our annual report just came out, and it shows that more than 90 percent of the stocks aren't being overfished. That's a big deal, and it's the result of decades of hard work by scientists, fishermen, and managers who have set catch limits based on the best available science. Of course, not everything is perfect. A handful of stocks are still rebuilding, and changing ocean conditions are making some harder to predict. But overall, the trend is moving in the right direction. If you're curious about what's on your dinner plate, check out the species profiles on our website, where you can find out how each fish is doing and how to buy sustainably.
